display_long_description:
Welcome to Xennial’s Virtual Reality (VR) Dissection Lab, designed for Middle and High School Biology programs. This innovative learning experience eliminates the need for physical specimens.

The VR Dissection Lab includes the following specimens: Worm, Clam, Crayfish, Fish, and Frog. The guided experiences allow students to master incisions and understand external and internal anatomy. An interactive gallery lets students review each specimen's anatomy before proceeding to the dissection. They are able to master the use of virtual tools like scissors, forceps, and a scalpel to dissect organisms. Xennial’s VR Dissection Lab also addresses logistical challenges, making high-quality education accessible by removing resource, storage, and cost barriers. The VR Lab extends learning beyond the classroom, enabling students to access it anywhere, promoting independent and unlimited practice and study. Xennial’s VR Dissection Lab is a transformative tool, providing a comprehensive, interactive alternative to traditional methods. 
 
The VR Dissection Lab offers the option to perform the dissections with full hand-tracking capabilities for more seamless use and adoption, while also offering the option to use the Meta Quest controllers. This enhanced version of the VR Dissection Lab is offered in English and Spanish.
